caption:
# GUI Interface Description

## System Top Bar
- **Left Side**: "Activities" button
- **Center**: "Files" application icon with a dropdown menu
- **Right Side**: 
  - Date and time display: "Oct 23 00:55"
  - Notification bell icon
  - System status icons (network, sound, power)

## Dropdown Menu (from "Files" application)
- **Menu Title**: "Files"
- **Menu Items**:
  - "New Window"
  - "Quit"

## Desktop Environment
- **Background**: Abstract geometric wallpaper with gradient from dark purple to red-orange
- **Desktop Icon**: "Home" folder icon located at bottom right corner

## Left Sidebar (Application Launcher)
- **Application Icons (top to bottom)**:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird email client
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC media player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP image editor
  - Files (current application)
  - Ubuntu Software (orange shopping bag icon)
  - Help (blue question mark icon)
  - Trash (recycle bin icon)
  - Application grid (9-dot icon at bottom)

## File Manager Window
- **Window Title**: "Home"
- **Window Controls** (top right):
  - Minimize button
  - Maximize button
  - Close button (X)
- **Navigation Controls** (top left):
  - Back button (left arrow)
  - Forward button (right arrow)
- **Address Bar**:
  - Home icon followed by "Home"
- **Toolbar** (center top):
  - Three-dot menu button
  - Search icon (magnifying glass)
  - View options button (three horizontal lines)
  - View options dropdown button (downward arrow)
- **Sidebar Navigation** (left side):
  - "Recent"
  - "Starred"
  - "Home" (currently selected)
  - "Desktop"
  - "Documents"
  - "Downloads"
  - "Music"
  - "Pictures"
  - "Videos"
  - "Trash"
  - "Other Locations" (with plus icon)

## File List (Main Content Area)
- **Grid Layout**: Files and folders displayed in a grid
- **Visible Folders**:
  - Desktop
  - Documents
  - Downloads
  - Music
  - Pictures
  - Public
  - server
  - snap
  - Templates
  - Videos
  - work_files
  - thunderbird
- **Visible Files**:
  - requirement.txt
  - .bash_history
  - .bash_logout
  - .bashrc
  - .cache
  - .config
  - .gnupg
  - .ipython
  - .lesshst
  - .local
  - .mozilla
  - .pki
  - .profile
  - .selected_editor
  - .ssh
  - .sudo_as_admin_successful
  - .var
  - .viminfo
  - .vscode
